new_result: For every fixed symmetric A with rank(A)>=3 and every independent product law with one-dimensional densities <=1, X^T A X has an instance-dependent bounded density with a representative in C_0(R). The zero-diagonal branch is proved by product-marginal L1-to-output-Linfinity stability on either a physical triangle or an invertible bipartite four-block; the nonzero-diagonal branch is supplied by the completed assigned partner.
absolute_continuity_ledger: Every nonzero quadratic pushforward of an absolutely continuous joint input is absolutely continuous by coarea away from ker A. This is strictly weaker than boundedness.
strict_controls: X uniform[0,1], Q=X^2: absolutely continuous but unbounded density 1/(2 sqrt t).
X,Y iid uniform[0,1], Q=X^2+Y^2: bounded density but no continuous representative at zero.
first_unpaid_target: Prove sup over all target instances of max_t p_Q(t) is finite. C_0 regularity makes each individual maximum attained but provides no uniform bound; aggregate original-coordinate product curvature before reciprocal local-minor payment.
next_step: Use attained-peak formulation to seek a grouped-coordinate/aggregate-curvature inequality that survives diffuse matrices; do not revisit conditional positive moments, pointwise Fourier envelopes, or one-minor dichotomies.
